memory_candidates.content: On this NixOS host, flake.nix's devPython (python.withPackages) does NOT get transitive Python dependencies the same way a pip venv does. code/src/model_checker/theory_lib/logos/protocols.py imports typing_extensions at module level but pyproject.toml never declares it -- a pip venv installing ipywidgets/jupyter/etc. pulls it in transitively, but the nixpkgs closure does not, so it must be listed explicitly in devPython (python312Packages.typing-extensions) or every test that collects the logos subtheory fails with a hard ModuleNotFoundError, not a skip. Same failure mode class as unittest.mock.patch needing ipywidgets to pre-exist as an attribute.

When writing rationale prose inside a CI workflow YAML comment that documents a forbidden flag (e.g. explaining why '-n auto' must never be used), a literal grep-based verification like `grep -n "n auto" file.yml` returning nothing will be tripped by the prose itself if it contains the exact substring. Reword explanatory comments to avoid the literal forbidden-flag substring (e.g. 'xdist's auto worker-count mode' instead of '-n auto') so the file both documents the rationale and passes a naive substring-absence check.
